raw_findings.evidence: cursor.execute("SELECT id, username, name, surname FROM users WHERE id=" + params["id"])
raw_findings.fix: Use parameterized queries like cursor.execute("SELECT id, username, name, surname FROM users WHERE id=?", (params["id"],))

raw_findings.issue: Unsafe deserialization using pickle.loads on untrusted input
raw_findings.fix: Avoid using pickle for untrusted data; use safer serialization formats like JSON.

raw_findings.issue: Command injection via subprocess with shell=True
raw_findings.evidence: content = subprocess.run("nslookup " + params["domain"], shell=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, errors="replace").stdout
raw_findings.fix: Use subprocess.run without shell=True and pass arguments as a list.
Avoid executing arbitrary code from untrusted inputs.

raw_findings.issue: SQL injection via string concatenation in authentication query
raw_findings.evidence: found = bool(cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username='" + re.sub(r"[^\w]", "", params.get("username", "")) + "' AND password='" + params.get("password", "") + "'").fetchall())
raw_findings.fix: Use parameterized queries for SQL operations.

raw_findings.issue: subprocess execution with shell=True and untrusted input
raw_findings.fix: Avoid using shell=True and pass command arguments as a list without shell execution.
